alternatives_rejected.why: CPU is elevated (z=60.66), but this is far smaller than the diskio deviation (z≈2e13) from a near-flat baseline. That pattern fits disk stress, with CPU rising as a side effect of I/O work (E1).

The all-services metric ranking shows no productcatalogservice deviations; the top deviations are all recommendationservice's own (E1). Recommendationservice's own span self-time also rose 2.66x, so the slowdown starts inside the service, not in a callee (E2).

proposed_fix.description: Find and stop the process or workload driving abnormal disk I/O in the recommendationservice pod (e.g., runaway logging, temp-file writes, or an injected stressor), then check that latency-50/90 return to baseline. If the source cannot be isolated quickly, do a rolling restart of the recommendationservice pod.
